claims.claim: E1/E2/I1 are fictional units that cannot be mapped to connectome cells
claims.evidence: Author CoreCPG keepOnly indices 277/617/1167 resolve to MANC 10707/11751/13905; official MaleCNS mancBodyid crosswalk resolves to 800173/800863/801884 respectively. These are absent from frozen R2.
claims.scope: Left T1 exact crosswalk; serial/type counterparts must not be confused with the same individual across animals.

claims.claim: Inhibitory cells stimulated alone in a silent network produce no MN output, therefore function fails
claims.reason: Need active excitatory background and target-specific suppression/disinhibition assay; quiet stimulation is not a test of braking.

claims.claim: Rdl missing from cell names means inhibitory receptor function absent
claims.reason: Rdl is receptor/gene; generic inhibitory conductance exists but receptor subtype and distribution are not modeled.
Presynaptic NT does not identify postsynaptic receptor; preserve baseline assumption explicitly and run sensitivity, do not call it physiology.
Repeated scopes, literature assertions, structural queries and untested behaviors are included; retain original verdicts as external reports only.

claims.claim: 144 proposed cells exist and are absent in R2
claims.evidence: Official MaleCNS annotation exact bodyId/type selection; build manifest records hashes.

claims.claim: More DN partners than a paper reports disproves recruitment
claims.reason: Dataset/subset, threshold, direct versus indirect reachability and recording conditions must match.

claims.claim: Repeated flashing proves the walking CPG drives muscles
claims.evidence: Our previous causal interventions locate tonic-driven DN bursting with distributed feedback inhibition, not a uniquely identified walking CPG. Exact T1 paper core was missing.
